Expt 3 analysis

Christine Soh Yue

2025-01-14, updated 2026-09-17

Set-up and libraries

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpattern)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggsignif)
library(penngradlings)
library(car)

# theme_set(theme_pgl_minimal())

theme_set(theme_minimal())

`%!in%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

c2 <- contr.treatment(2)
coding2 <- matrix(rep(1/2, 2), ncol=1)
simple2 <- c2-coding2

expt3_model_order <- c("Human", "MIGHT", "TRACE", "Pursuit", "FUb", "FUb-fixed")

Models

expt3_fubg <- tibble(
  "experiment" = c(3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3),
  "condition" = c("Conflict-first", "Conflict-first", "Confirm-first", "Confirm-first",
                  "Conflict-first", "Conflict-first", "Confirm-first", "Confirm-first"), 
  "word_type" = c("target", "filler", "target", "filler", 
                  "target", "filler", "target", "filler"), 
  "count" = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1), 
  "mean_acc" = c(0.344, 0.222, 0.344, 0.222,
                 0.327, 0.286, 0.215, 0.289), 
  "sd_acc" = c(NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA), 
  "se_acc" = c(NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA), 
  "model" = c("FUb", "FUb", "FUb", "FUb", 
             "FUb-fixed", "FUb-fixed", "FUb-fixed", "FUb-fixed")
)

expt3_models <- read_csv("../model_code/results/might_expt3_results.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    expt = "MIGHT"
  ) %>%
  rbind(mutate(read_csv("../model_code/results/pursuit_expt3_results.csv"), expt = "Pursuit")) %>%
  group_by(condition, experiment, word_type, model) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_acc = mean(accuracy),
    sd_acc = NA,
    se_acc = NA,
    count = n()
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    word_type = factor(word_type, levels=c("target", "filler"))
  ) %>%
  select(
    "experiment", "condition", "word_type", "count", "mean_acc", "sd_acc", "se_acc", "model"
  ) %>%
  rbind(expt3_fubg) %>%
  mutate(
    model = factor(case_when(
      model == "pursuit" ~ "Pursuit",
      model == "might" ~ "MIGHT",
      model == "trace" ~ "TRACE",
      model == "Human" ~ "Human",
      TRUE ~ model
    ), levels = expt3_model_order
  )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    word_type == "target"
  )

Experiment 3

expt3_raw_data <- read_csv("expt3_data.csv") %>%
  mutate(expt = 3)
## Rows: 5307 Columns: 11
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Delimiter: ","
## chr (8): condition, phase, item, exposure, word, word_type, selected_object,...
## dbl (3): experiment, id, target_selected
## 
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
## ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
expt3_excluded_participants <- expt3_raw_data %>%
  filter(
    phase == "debrief",
    (item == "Cheat" & input != "My data is good") | (item == "WriteDown") & grepl("yes", input) | (item == "WriteDown") & grepl("wrote", input)
  ) %>%
  select(
    id, condition, item, input
  )

expt3_excluded_participants
## # A tibble: 6 × 4
##      id condition      item      input                                      
##   <dbl> <chr>          <chr>     <chr>                                      
## 1     6 Conflict-first Cheat     Select an answer                           
## 2    19 Confirm-first  Cheat     Discard my data                            
## 3    27 Confirm-first  Cheat     Discard my data                            
## 4    39 Confirm-first  WriteDown Yes I wrote down what I thought each round 
## 5    46 Confirm-first  Cheat     Discard my data                            
## 6    94 Confirm-first  WriteDown I wrote down what I picked for each answer.
expt3_data <- expt3_raw_data %>%
  filter(id %!in% expt3_excluded_participants$id)
expt3_data %>%
  filter(phase == "test") %>%
  group_by(condition, word, word_type) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(target_selected), item = min(item))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'condition', 'word'. You can override using
## the `.groups` argument.

##  6 Confirm-first kuabid  filler    0.390 49

##  9 Confirm-first ruftin  filler    0.512 46   
## 10 Confirm-first smick   filler    0.220 51   
## # ℹ 18 more rows
expt3_data %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n_distinct(id)
  )
## # A tibble: 2 × 2
##   condition      count
##   <chr>          <int>
## 1 Confirm-first     41
## 2 Conflict-first    40

Testing

expt3_selected_twice_target <- expt3_data %>%
  filter(
    phase == "learning",
    word_type == "target" & exposure == 2
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    index = paste(condition, id, word),
    selected_twice = target_selected
  ) %>%
  select(index, selected_twice)

expt3_selected_twice_filler <- expt3_data %>%
  filter(
    phase == "learning",
    word_type == "filler" & exposure == 2
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    index = paste(condition, id, word),
    selected_twice = 2
  ) %>%
  select(index, selected_twice)

expt3_selected_twice <- expt3_selected_twice_target %>%
  rbind(expt3_selected_twice_filler)

expt3_testing <- expt3_data %>%
  filter(
    phase == "test"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    accuracy = as.integer(target_selected),
    condition = factor(condition),
    index = paste(condition, id, word)
  ) %>%
  left_join(expt3_selected_twice)
## Joining with `by = join_by(index)`
expt3_aggr_test <- expt3_testing %>%
  filter(selected_twice > 0) %>%
  group_by(
    condition, word_type
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    mean_acc = mean(accuracy),
    sd_acc = sd(accuracy),
    se_acc = sd_acc / sqrt(count)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    word_type = factor(word_type, levels = c("target", "filler")),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c ("Confirm-first", "Conflict-first"))
  )
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'condition'. You can override using the
## `.groups` argument.
expt3_annotation_df <- data.frame(
  model = c("Human"),
  start = c(1),
  end = c(2),
  y_pos = 0.70,
  label = "^ p = 0.056"
)
expt3_annotation_df$model <- factor(expt3_annotation_df$model, levels = expt3_model_order)

  
ggplot(filter(expt3_aggr_test
              , word_type=="target"
              ), aes(x=condition, y=mean_acc
                                    , fill=word_type
                     , fill = condition
                                    )) +
  geom_col(position="dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=
                        c("#b2abd2", "#e66101", "#fbd863")
                    ) +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  labs(
      x = "Experimental Condition",
      y = "Accuracy at test",
      fill = "Word type"
    ) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(x=condition, ymin=mean_acc+se_acc,
                    ymax=mean_acc-se_acc),
                width=.2,
                position=position_dodge(.9)) +
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12),
        axis.title=element_text(size=16,face="bold"),
        legend.title=element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        legend.text=element_text(size=14),
        title=element_text(size=16,face="bold"),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 14)
        ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=(1/12), linetype='dotted')

Statistical analysis

expt3_test_model_data <- expt3_testing %>%
  filter(selected_twice > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    condition = factor(condition, levels=c("Conflict-first", "Confirm-first")),
    word_type = factor(word_type),
    noun = factor(word),
    offset = 1/12
  )
filtered_test <-  filter(expt3_test_model_data, 
                         word_type == "target", selected_twice == 1
                         ) 
expt3_target_model <- glmer(accuracy ~ condition + (1 | id)  + offset(log(offset/(1 - offset))),
               data=filtered_test, family="binomial")
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
expt3_target_model <- glm(accuracy ~ condition  + offset(log(offset/(1 - offset))),
               data=filtered_test, family="binomial")
summary(expt3_target_model)
## 
## Call:
## glm(formula = accuracy ~ condition + offset(log(offset/(1 - offset))), 
##     family = "binomial", data = filtered_test)
## 
## Coefficients:
##                        Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)    
## (Intercept)              1.8101     0.1859   9.736   <2e-16 ***
## conditionConfirm-first   0.4925     0.2577   1.911    0.056 .  
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## (Dispersion parameter for binomial family taken to be 1)
## 
##     Null deviance: 342.31  on 251  degrees of freedom
## Residual deviance: 338.63  on 250  degrees of freedom
## AIC: 342.63
## 
## Number of Fisher Scoring iterations: 4

Aggregate

expt3_test_all <- expt3_aggr_test %>%
  mutate( model = "Human", part = "human", experiment = 3 ) %>%
  rbind(mutate(expt3_models, part = "model")) %>%
  mutate(
    model = factor(model, levels = expt3_model_order),
    cond = factor(case_when(
      condition == "Conflict-first" ~ "Conflict-\nfirst",
      condition == "Confirm-first" ~ "Confirm-\nfirst"
    ), levels = c("Confirm-\nfirst", "Conflict-\nfirst"))
  )


expt3_all_plot <- ggplot(filter(expt3_test_all, word_type == "target"), 
               aes(x=cond, y=mean_acc, 
                   fill = cond
                 )) +
  facet_grid(cols=vars(model)) +
  geom_col_pattern(aes(pattern = part), position="dodge", pattern_spacing = 0.1) +
  scale_pattern_manual(values=c("wave", "stripe"), guide="none") +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=
                        c("#5f1c99", "#e66101")
                    , guide = "none"
                    ) +
  labs(
      x = "Experimental Condition",
      y = "Accuracy at test",
      fill = "Word type"
    ) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(x=cond, ymin=mean_acc+se_acc,
                    ymax=mean_acc-se_acc),
                width=.3,
                position=position_dodge(.9)) +
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12),
        axis.title=element_text(size=16,face="bold"),
        legend.title=element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        legend.text=element_text(size=14),
        title=element_text(size=16,face="bold"),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 14)
        ) +
  geom_signif(
    data = expt3_annotation_df,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, annotations = label, y_position = y_pos),
    manual = TRUE, # Use 'manual = TRUE' when providing aesthetics via a data frame
    inherit.aes = FALSE # Do not inherit aesthetics from the main ggplot() call
    ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=(1/9), linetype='dotted')
expt3_all_plot

ggsave("expt3_test.png", width=10, height=4, units="in", dpi="print")

expt3_model_by_word <- expt3_models <- read_csv("../model_code/results/might_expt3_results.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    expt = "MIGHT"
  ) %>%
  rbind(mutate(read_csv("../model_code/results/pursuit_expt3_results.csv"), expt = "Pursuit")) %>%
  group_by(condition, experiment, word, word_type, model) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_acc = mean(accuracy),
    sd_acc = NA,
    count = n(),
    se_acc = NA
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    word_s = case_when(
      word == 1 ~ 11,
      word == 2 ~ 12,
      word == 3 ~ 13,
      word == 4 ~ 14,
      TRUE ~ word - 4
    ),
    word_type = factor(word_type, levels=c("target", "filler")),
    word = word_s
  ) %>%
  select(
    "experiment", "condition", "word", "word_type", "count", "mean_acc", "sd_acc", "se_acc", "model"
  ) %>%
  rbind(expt3_fubg_by_word) %>%
  mutate(
    model = factor(case_when(
      model == "pursuit" ~ "Pursuit",
      model == "might" ~ "MIGHT",
      model == "Human" ~ "Human",
      TRUE ~ model
    ), levels = expt3_model_order
  )
  )

expt3_model_wider <- expt3_model_by_word %>%

expt3_by_word <- expt3_testing %>%
  filter(selected_twice > 0) %>%
  group_by(
    experiment, condition, word, word_type
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_acc = mean(accuracy),
    sd_acc = sd(accuracy),
    count = n(),
    se_acc = sd_acc / sqrt(count),
    word = min(as.integer(item)) - 42
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    model = "Human"
  )
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'experiment', 'condition', 'word'. You can
## override using the `.groups` argument.
correlation <- ggplot(mutate(rbind(expt3_by_word, 
                                   filter(expt3_model_by_word,
                                          model != "Pursuit\n(perfect)")),
                             model = factor(model, levels = c("Human", "MBP", 
                                                              "Pursuit", "FUb", 
                                                              "FUb-fixed")),
                             word = case_when(
                               word_type == "Target" ~ word - 10,
                               TRUE ~ word
                             )
                             ), aes(x=word, linetype = model, color = model)) +
  geom_point(aes(y=mean_acc, shape = model)) +
  geom_line(aes(y=mean_acc)) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(condition, word_type), scale = "free_x", space="free_x") +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(1, 10, by=1))

correlation

expt3_model_me <- expt3_model_wider %>%
  mutate(
    item = word + 42
  )

cor_model <- expt3_test_model_data %>%
  mutate(
    item = as.integer(item)
  ) %>%
  left_join(expt3_model_me, by=c("item", "condition", "word_type")) %>%
  filter(selected_twice > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    condition = factor(condition),
    word_type = factor(word_type),
    noun = factor(word.x),
    offset = 1/12
  )

contrasts(cor_model$condition) <- simple2
contrasts(cor_model$word_type) <- simple2
expt3_target_model <- glmer(accuracy ~ condition * word_type  + (1 + word_type | id)  + (1 | word.x) 
                              + offset(log(offset/(1 - offset))),
               data=filter(cor_model, selected_twice > 0
                         ) , family="binomial")
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
summary(expt3_target_model)
## Generalized linear mixed model fit by maximum likelihood (Laplace
##   Approximation) [glmerMod]
##  Family: binomial  ( logit )
## Formula: accuracy ~ condition * word_type + (1 + word_type | id) + (1 |  
##     word.x) + offset(log(offset/(1 - offset)))
##    Data: filter(cor_model, selected_twice > 0)
## 
##      AIC      BIC   logLik deviance df.resid 
##   1279.7   1319.4   -631.8   1263.7     1054 
## 
## Scaled residuals: 
##     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
## -1.1297 -0.6692 -0.5126  1.0650  2.2594 
## 
## Random effects:
##  Groups Name        Variance Std.Dev. Corr 
##  id     (Intercept) 0.16480  0.4060        
##         word_type2  0.13968  0.3737   -1.00
##  word.x (Intercept) 0.01942  0.1393        
## Number of obs: 1062, groups:  id, 81; word.x, 14
##
